text: <highlight>BorgBackup (borg)</highlight> is a deduplicating backup tool used to create compressed and encrypted backups. System administrators commonly use it to store snapshots of directories. If an attacker finds a borg archive and its passphrase, they can extract sensitive files from the backup.
A borg repository named <highlight>final_archive</highlight> was discovered in the developer directory. This indicates that backups were created using Borg.
The borg repository contains a snapshot named <highlight>music_archive</highlight>. Snapshots are backups of directories taken at specific times.
Using <highlight>borg extract</highlight>, the contents of the backup snapshot were restored into the current directory.
After extraction, files from the backup were restored. These files may contain credentials, configuration files, or sensitive data useful for privilege escalation.
Why Borg Backups Are Valuable for Attackers

title: Security Impact
items: Backup archives often contain full copies of user directories.
They may include SSH keys, passwords, configuration files, or source code.
If attackers obtain the borg passphrase, they can restore the entire backup.
Developers frequently store backups in insecure directories.

title: Steps Performed
items: Discovered a borg repository in the developer directory
Listed available backup snapshots using borg list
Extracted the backup using borg extract
Recovered files from the backup for further enumeration
